note: Two sites on old log landings in the woods on the north side of Little Valley Road, about 2.8 miles (043) and 3.2 miles (044) west of PA 850, each at the end of its own gravel driveway. The booking page grades 044's driveway Moderate. It sells 043 as a trailer site, while DCNR's campsite map layer lists 043 as having no trailer access. Each has a picnic table and stone fire ring; no toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: 043 and 044 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 25 ft, pull-in gravel driveways of 130 ft (Slight) and 230 ft (Moderate), clearance 15 ft, picnic tables; count 2 and 25 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; both sell in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. PASDA leaf-off imagery shows a clearing at the end of a track for each site, about 60 m (043) and 75 m (044) west of the agency points, which sit near the driveway mouths. NHD: Little Valley Creek 179 m from 043; not waterfront.
